nodes.name: Get MIDI File
nodes.description: Gets a MIDI provided a path to the file with the file picker.

inputs.name: File Path
inputs.description: Absolute path to a .mid file on disk.

outputs.name: Tracks
outputs.description: All tracks in the MIDI file with their notes and controller events.

outputs.name: MIDI Stats
outputs.description: Human-readable track count and duration.

nodes.name: Get MIDI Track Data
nodes.description: Gets a MIDI track's data from an array of MIDI Tracks.

inputs.name: Tracks
inputs.description: Tracks to pick from, usually from Get MIDI File.

inputs.name: Track Name
inputs.description: Name of the track to extract; must exactly match a track name.

outputs.name: Notes
outputs.description: Notes of the selected track, times in seconds.

outputs.name: Control Change
outputs.description: Control change events of the selected track, keyed by CC number.

outputs.name: Pitchwheel
outputs.description: Pitch wheel events of the selected track.

outputs.name: Aftertouch
outputs.description: Aftertouch events of the selected track.

nodes.name: Keyframes from Object
nodes.description: Get keyframes from an object in the scene.

inputs.name: ObjectGroups
inputs.description: Object groups from the scene, usually from Scene Link.

inputs.name: Object Group Name
inputs.description: Name of the object group that contains the source object.

inputs.name: Object Name
inputs.description: Name of the object whose animation curves are read.

outputs.name: Dynamic Output
outputs.description: One output per animation curve on the object, e.g. location_z.

nodes.name: Animation Generator
nodes.description: Create animation generators based on keyframed data

inputs.name: Name
inputs.description: Name of the generator; objects reference their animation by this name.

inputs.name: Note On Keyframes
inputs.description: Animation curve played at each note-on, timed relative to the note start.

inputs.name: Note On Anchor Point
inputs.description: Time offset added to every note-on keyframe.

inputs.name: Note Off Keyframes
inputs.description: Animation curve played at each note-off, timed relative to the note end.

inputs.name: Note Off Anchor Point
inputs.description: Time offset added to every note-off keyframe.

inputs.name: Time Mapper
inputs.description: Reserved; not used by the executor yet.

inputs.name: Amplitude Mapper
inputs.description: Reserved; not used by the executor yet.

inputs.name: Velocity Intensity
inputs.description: Scales keyframe values by note velocity; 0 ignores velocity.

inputs.name: Animation Overlap
inputs.description: How a note combines with an animation still playing on the same curve: add, min, max, prev (previous), next, rvc (rest value crossing), prune (keyframe pruning) or crossfade. Empty = add.

inputs.name: Overlap Blend
inputs.description: Crossfade only: seconds to ease from the animation still playing into the note. Unset = 0.1.

inputs.name: Animation Property
inputs.description: Blender data path like location[2]. Empty = inherit from note-on keyframes.

outputs.name: Animation Generator
outputs.description: The generator settings, consumed by Assign Notes to Objects.

nodes.name: Assign Notes to Objects
nodes.description: Assign notes to objects in the scene

inputs.name: ObjectGroups
inputs.description: Object groups from the scene, usually from Scene Link.

inputs.name: Object Group Name
inputs.description: Name of the object group whose objects receive notes.

inputs.name: Notes
inputs.description: Notes to distribute; each unique pitch is assigned to one object in order.

inputs.name: Animation Generator
inputs.description: Animation generator applied to every object in the group.

outputs.name: Object Map
outputs.description: Mapping of object names to note numbers and animation generators.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Any value to display in the node.

outputs.name: Name
outputs.description: Name of the linked Blender scene.

outputs.name: Object Groups
outputs.description: Object groups (collections) in the linked scene with their objects.

nodes.name: Merge Object Maps
nodes.description: Merge object maps so objects can have several animations

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Object maps to merge, a new input appears for each one connected. Objects in several maps get the animations of all of them, each keeping its own notes; two different generators with the same name are an error.

outputs.name: Object Map
outputs.description: The merged object map, connect to Evaluate Instrument.

nodes.name: Scene Writer
nodes.description: Write keyframes to the Blender scene

inputs.name: Keyframes
inputs.description: Keyframes per object from Evaluate Instrument. Each object's existing animation is cleared before writing.

nodes.name: Group
nodes.description: Runs a node group. Its sockets come from the group's Group Input and Group Output. Press Tab to open it.

nodes.name: Group Input
nodes.description: Inside a node group: the values given to the group node's inputs.

nodes.name: Group Output
nodes.description: Inside a node group: the values the group node outputs.

nodes.name: For Each
nodes.description: Start of a for each zone. The nodes between it and its For Each Output run once per item.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.description: The list to loop over.

outputs.name: Element
outputs.description: The current item.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.description: Position of the current item, starting at 0.

outputs.name: Count
outputs.description: Number of items.

outputs.name: Previous
outputs.description: The item before the current one, nothing for the first.

outputs.name: Next
outputs.description: The item after the current one, nothing for the last.

nodes.name: For Each Output
nodes.description: End of a for each zone. Collects what reaches Result on each item into a list.

inputs.name: Result
inputs.description: Value to collect for the current item.

outputs.name: Results
outputs.description: The collected values, one per item in order.

nodes.name: Note Targets
nodes.description: Lists which objects, with which animation, each note number triggers.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Object-to-note mapping from Assign Notes to Objects.

outputs.name: Targets
outputs.description: Objects and animations per note number.

nodes.name: Targets for Note
nodes.description: The objects and animations one note triggers.

inputs.name: Targets
inputs.description: Targets per note number from Note Targets.

inputs.name: Note
inputs.description: The note to look up.

outputs.name: Targets
outputs.description: What this note triggers, empty if nothing.

nodes.name: Note Keyframes
nodes.description: The keyframes one note plays on one target: the generator's keys moved to the note's time and scaled by velocity.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Where the target's animation is looked up.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: Object and the name of the animation to play.

inputs.name: Note
inputs.description: The note that plays it.

outputs.name: Keys
outputs.description: Keyframes on the target's curve, nothing if the generator has no keys.

nodes.name: Combine Keyframes
nodes.description: Combines every note's keys per object and curve in note order, using each generator's animation overlap mode.

inputs.name: Object Map
inputs.description: Every object in the map gets keyframes, objects with no notes are cleared.

inputs.name: Keys
inputs.description: CurveKeys from Note Keyframes in note order, lists inside lists are flattened.

outputs.name: Keyframes
outputs.description: Keyframes per object. Connect to Scene Writer to write them to Blender.
